page: Microsoft Azure E8ds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz, the instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is configured at 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per virtual processor. The instance includes 322 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage, while containing zero dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark assessments display typical mid-tier throughput across standard computational and memory benchmarks. The instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 8,586.74 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4,448.0, with single-core results showing moderate capabilities. Memory subsystem performance yielded 49.8 GB/sec read and 35.19 GB/sec write bandwidth on large 256 MB uncached blocks. In application benchmarks, the instance sustained 7.09 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.32 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. However, complex vector and medium-scale LLM inference workloads show distinct computational boundaries, with 7B parameter prompt processing tracking at 14.31 tokens per second.

With its 8:1 memory-to-core allocation and attached high-speed local SSD, the E8ds_v4 offers solid resource density for caching platforms, relational databases, in-memory data structures, and enterprise backend applications requiring large active memory footprints without excess compute overhead.
